question: The Indian Institute of Remote Sensing was established at ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dehradun.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Indian Institute of Remote Sensing **is a leading institution for **research, advanced study, and training** in

 
 
• remote sensing,
 
• geoinformatics, and
 
• GPS technology for managing natural resources,
 
• the environment, and
 
• natural disasters.
 
 
 
• It falls within the **purview** of the **1966**-founded **Indian Department of Space.**
 
• It is situated in the **Uttarakhand city of Dehradun.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• On **February 27,** the** NASA Kenedy Space Center **in** Cape Canaveral **will launch the **Crew-6 mission.**
 
• It is a cooperative effort between **SpaceX and NASA.**
 
• The **SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket** will transport the Crew Dragon spacecraft.
 
• It is being sent to the **International Space Station** in a capsule.
 
• Two** American astronauts, a Russian cosmonaut,** and an astronaut from the UAE will be launched on this mission.
 
• The mission's landing zone is in the **Atlantic Ocean.**
 
• It is a component of** NASA's Commercial Crew **Program.
 
• The program offers crew **transportation services,** which include **moving astronauts **and **cargo** to and from the ISS.
